official_definition: And similar to Contract Advent, you can Flag Contract Advent onto your Contract Nexus cards (Flag Nexuses) that are in Soul State via the effect written on the Contract Nexus cards. When adventing on cards in Soul State, you can put as many cores as you want from the Field/Reserve to the now advente

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Flag Contract Advent] or [Flag Contract Advent: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Flag Contract Advent]", "give [Flag Contract Advent]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
